items.title: Cymbal Domestic Chicken Tender Tatsuta-age (Frozen)
items.description: Tender domestic chicken breast strips marinated in a soy-sauce seasoning, coated in potato starch and fried until crisp. Just microwave straight from frozen (about 2 min 30 sec at 600W). Great for bento boxes or as an extra dinner side. Net weight: 300g (about 12 pcs) / Ingredient origin: Domestic / Storage: keep at -18°C or below / Allergens: wheat, soybean, chicken / Best before: 12 months from manufacture

items.title: Hokkaido Autumn Salmon Fillets, Lightly Salted, 4 fillets
items.description: Rich, fatty Hokkaido autumn salmon fillets, lightly salted. Just grill for breakfast or bento. In season: September–November. 4 fillets (about 320g). Keep refrigerated (10°C or below).

items.title: Cymbal Lightweight Induction-Ready Deep Frying Pan 26cm
items.category: Kitchen > Frying Pans & Pots > Frying Pans
items.description: A lightweight deep frying pan with a cast-aluminum body and titanium-reinforced fluororesin coating that resists sticking. Stir-fry or simmer, all in one pan. Works on induction and gas (200V induction OK). Dishwasher safe. Size: 26cm diameter × 7.5cm deep, weight approx. 780g.
